coverage.method: Tracked HEAD blobs only. Python candidates require def main(...) or a __main__ guard. Caller matching is lexical against bounded maintained launch/document corpus, therefore UNKNOWN means no concrete caller located, not inactive.
limitations: Lexical caller matching cannot prove dynamic import, external cron/systemd not tracked here, or activation of a documented command.
No raw vector/artifact corpus traversal, expensive execution, live services, model calls, or network access.
Location class distinguishes HSWM implementation, HSWM research, compatibility/root, and tool profiles; it does not establish legal or vendor ownership.
UNKNOWN is an unclassified review backlog: it is not evidence that an entrypoint is inert or unreachable.
